summary: Pictures are built from the brand: name, handle, bio, notes and idea go into every Grok prompt, the style starts at the one that suits the account (kids or quotes -> illustrated), Fill form's picture idea is used, and a non-person brand gets no human faces (0.32.1).

spots.note: BrandContext, isAboutPerson, suggestStyle, pictureIdeaFor, describeBrand; buildPrompt/buildRefinePrompt take an optional context
context and suggestedStyle props set the starting description and style and shape every prompt
keeps Fill form's imagePrompt/imageStyle and passes the brand context to the picture studio
brand page picture studio starts from the brand's bio and style, prompts carry the brand context
picture studio gets the account's name, handle, bio and notes
PROFILE_GUIDE: kids, animal and topic accounts get their mascot or subject, never a person
Fill form picture idea drives the studio
